subject: PDP Test 002 protocol-evaluation plan
statement: A complete execution of the current Test 002 plan will produce enough information to classify protocol adherence and calculate the prespecified per-decision Brier comparison, but will not by itself establish general effectiveness.
fails_if: The declared capture and outcome records are insufficient to classify adherence or calculate the prespecified score, or a single decision is treated as general validation.
scope: Feasibility and inferential limits of one planned test, not comparative effectiveness.
status_note: The plan is unexecuted. This prediction is not commit-ordered because the research repository has not been committed; it must be registered in a new commit before Test 002 begins.
